text:
Priya Rao: quick heads-up — we have an incident affecting a subset of EU new onboarders. Some onboarding webhooks and initial embedding requests are returning 5xx. Eng is looking into root cause. Need outreach plan + credits/enablement offer.
Marcus Li: noted. Eng-oncall assigned? can we get exact tenant list and severity?
CS Ops Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3412 — assigned to Maria Chen (eng-oncall).
Maria Chen: investigating now. preliminary triage: autoscale / cache eviction interaction in dedicated EU pool. Hotfix branch created, PR in review. ETA ~40m for patch + rolling restart.
Elena Gomez: thanks. I'll draft customer-facing blurb. proposal: immediate short status + estimated ETA + mitigation steps + credits offer + link to ticket. Want to confirm offer amount.
Samir Patel: I'll own outreach to priority accounts (top 15 by ARR). Can someone drop the impacted tenant list here? I need owner contacts.
Marcus Li: eng will dump impacted tenant IDs in the incident doc in the next 10m. Maria — please include reason for selection so we can be clear.
Maria Chen: will do. root cause summary (short): aggressive prefetch + KV cache eviction race when onboarding batch size > 5k tokens. causes transient mem pressure and 502/503 on webhook workers. Mitigation: disable prefetch for affected pool, restart workers, and apply patch to KV client to add backpressure.
Priya Rao: draft customer note (short, sendable):
```
Hi <Customer>,\nWe’re currently investigating intermittent 5xx errors impacting some new tenant onboarding requests in our EU region.\nWhat we’re doing: disabling a prefetch optimization and restarting the onboarding pool; applying a patch to prevent cache eviction races.\nEstimated time to recovery: 40 min — 2 hours.\nWhat we’ll do for you: two weeks of platform credits applied automatically + a dedicated onboarding help session (30-60m) if you want deeper assistance.\nTicket: INC-2026-3412 — we’ll follow up with an RCA when complete.\nApologies for the disruption.\n```
Elena Gomez: that reads well. I'll tailor two versions: one short email for all affected, one expanded note for priority accounts. Samir — want me to include a calendar link for the enablement session?
Samir Patel: yes please — include link. For priority accounts I’ll follow up with phone calls after the email goes out.
Marcus Li: add to talking points for phone calls: concrete mitigation steps, timeline for permanent fix (2 business days to stabilize + 7 days for full qa), and assurance about data integrity (no data loss).
Priya Rao: also flag renewals — if any priority accounts have renewals in next 60 days, escalate to me and I’ll join the call.
Maria Chen: patch merged, rolling restart started on pool-12 EU. currently ~30% of workers restarted, error rate dropping. I’ll post another update in 10m.
CS Ops Bot: Update INC-2026-3412: patch rolled to 50% of targets.
Elena Gomez: outreach plan timeline: 1) 30m: send short status email to all affected; 2) 45m: prioritized phone outreach to top 15; 3) 24h: consolidated RCA + mitigation note.
Priya Rao: checklist for CS before send: 1) confirm impacted tenant list attached, 2) include credits wording, 3) attach incident link, 4) include contact owner.
Samir Patel: I’ll assemble the contact sheet and drop in the thread in 10m. tagging @Priya Rao for exec escalations.
Marcus Li: one more thing — engineering will follow up with a more technical RCA (kernel-level memory usage graphs + request traces). Elena, we can include a simplified appendix for customers who want detail.
Elena Gomez: perfect. I’ll prepare both versions. sending note after Maria confirms error rate below threshold.
Priya Rao: thanks team. Goal: email out initial notice in 30m, phone touches for high-risk accounts within the hour, credits applied proactively. Keep updates short here.
Maria Chen: quick update — error spike reduced by 70% after current restarts. continuing rollout. will update when at 100%.
Samir Patel: contact sheet posted: sheet link (internal) — will start calls in 20m for top 10.
Elena Gomez: sending staged email now (first batch: priority accounts). copying the message body used above.
Priya Rao: received. please paste any customer replies here. I'll track renewal risk and follow up with finance for credit processing if needed.
Maria Chen: patch fully rolled, post-rollout monitoring in progress. planning a short RCA draft in ~48 hours and final RCA in 72 hours.
Marcus Li: great work. once RCA ready, let's decide on a short public-facing postmortem vs. per-customer notes.
Priya Rao: agree. for now: customer-facing follow-ups per outreach plan. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
